ui-prompts.admin.claudeFresh.off: Off (default): existing conversations take the new text after the context is compacted; you can "Compact now and apply"
ui-prompts.admin.claudeFresh.on: On: changes reach the listed sessions on the next turn (--system-prompt-snapshot off). Cost and stability have not been checked on long sessions
ui-prompts.admin.claudeFresh.title: Experiment: Claude Code rebuilds the system prompt on every request (only the list below)
ui-prompts.admin.freshLabel: Experiment list: one session ID per line (empty = nobody)
ui-prompts.admin.listLabel: List: one session ID per line
ui-prompts.admin.modeNow: Now: {mode}. When on, the control plane composes a session's system layer as "startup core → session note → owner's note → safety rules" and sends it down; it applies only on execution nodes that declare support, and when turned off the next turn is back as before.
ui-prompts.admin.orgRead.off: Off: no organisation layer is injected
ui-prompts.admin.orgRead.onWhileOff: While layered prompts are off, nothing is read or reported; once on, it is read every 10 minutes
ui-prompts.admin.orgRead.title: Execution nodes read and report the organisation startup core
ui-prompts.admin.pruned: Entries no longer there were removed from the list: {items}
ui-prompts.admin.staticRules.off: Off: each turn adds the full instructions as before
ui-prompts.admin.staticRules.on: On: each turn adds only one command line
ui-prompts.admin.staticRules.title: Put the static collaboration and workspace rules into the system layer
ui-prompts.apply.batch: The last "Apply now" still has {n, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} unfinished: it can run again once they finish or their queue is cancelled.
ui-prompts.apply.cancelBatch: Cancel the {n} not yet started in this batch
ui-prompts.apply.cancelled: Cancelled {n} not yet started{still}. What the owners started themselves is not affected.
ui-prompts.apply.status: After the startup core is updated, it takes effect by default when each session's process restarts and compacts its context on its own. "Apply now" has run {epoch} times; compaction queue: waiting {waiting}, running {running}, done {done}, skipped or failed {skipped}.
ui-prompts.apply.stillRunning: ; {n} more are already compacting and will finish
ui-prompts.applyNow.explain: Compacting has the AI summarise this conversation's context (one summary of allowance); after that the system prompt is the latest text.
ui-prompts.applyState.failed: The last compaction did not bring in the new text
ui-prompts.applyState.waiting: Queued: compacts when this conversation is idle
ui-prompts.card.whoEditable: the owner can rewrite it, turn it off, or restore the default.
ui-prompts.card.whoToggle: the owner can turn it on or off (the text is {product}'s default and cannot be rewritten).
ui-prompts.core.cp: The startup core the control plane read itself: v{version} · {sha} · {time}. Text reported by execution nodes is only used to check it, and refused when it differs.
ui-prompts.core.cpExpired: The copy the control plane last checked (expired): v{version} · {sha} · {time}. The organisation platform cannot be read now ({problem}); sessions keep using this copy, and text reported by execution nodes does not replace it.
ui-prompts.core.knowsMark: The text knows the "{mark}" mark: it can be turned on for every session.
ui-prompts.core.noAuthority: No authoritative source: only a list pilot (at most {max} people), not every session.
ui-prompts.core.noneNoExpected: No expected hash has been entered either.
ui-prompts.core.noneNoReport: No node has reported a text matching the expected hash yet.
ui-prompts.core.oldMark: The text is an old version (it does not know the "{mark}" mark): only a list pilot, not every session.
ui-prompts.core.runner: Text reported by an execution node whose hash matches the expected hash (sha {sha}); the control plane did not check the text itself: {problem}.
ui-prompts.core.sourceLabel: Source of the organisation startup core ({doc})
ui-prompts.countOver: {n} / {max} characters (over the limit, cannot be saved)
ui-prompts.delivery.injected: added to the thread as a developer message
ui-prompts.delivery.recorded: the engine keeps the system prompt recorded when the conversation began until it is compacted
ui-prompts.dialog.engine: What {product} does not show and cannot change: {owned}. {product}'s tools ({n}): {tools}. Turns the AI starts itself carry no text added by {product}.
ui-prompts.dialog.perTurn: Added every turn (the Runner adds it at the end of the turn's message)
ui-prompts.dialog.showFull: See the full composed system layer
ui-prompts.dialog.statusOff: Layered prompts are not in effect for this session: {why}. Below is what it would get once they are.
ui-prompts.dialog.statusOn: {product} adds this session's system layer in four layers, {chars} characters in all (the limit when the owner saves: {max}). The safety rules always come last.
ui-prompts.dialog.title: This session's prompt
ui-prompts.estimate.explain: Each execution node compacts one at a time, 30 seconds apart, waiting while a session is busy; queued ones can be cancelled. Every session's process restarts on its next turn; Codex sessions add the new text to the thread at their next start. Recorded under your name. Use it only when red lines or key rules change. This estimate is valid for a few minutes and can be confirmed once; if the sessions to compact change in the meantime, estimate again.
ui-prompts.estimate.none: No Claude session needs compacting now (all are up to date, or unused for 7 days): nothing to do, nothing will change.
ui-prompts.estimate.some: This compacts {sessions, plural, one {# Claude session} other {# Claude sessions}} belonging to {owners, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} ({people}). Each session spends one summary of its whole context. Once you confirm, {immediate} of them (one per execution node) start compacting at once and cannot be cancelled; the rest queue and can be cancelled.{truncated}
ui-prompts.estimate.truncated: At most {limit} at a time, most recently used first; {n} more are not in this round — they take effect at their next compaction, or press again.
ui-prompts.expected.explain: When the control plane cannot read the organisation platform itself, only reported text whose hash matches this is used, and a list pilot needs it first; when the control plane can read it, this is not used. Work it out yourself before entering it: {hint} (take the 64 hex digits of the output). Do not copy a hash a node reported below. When the startup core is updated, work it out and enter it again; until then sessions keep using the copy that matches the old hash.
ui-prompts.expected.label: Expected hash (SHA-256 of the startup core's text)
ui-prompts.expected.unseen: ; no node has reported a matching text yet
ui-prompts.history.title: Change history
ui-prompts.launch.file: The engine also reads: {path} ({bytes, plural, one {# byte} other {# bytes}})
ui-prompts.launch.memory: Auto-memory index: {path} ({bytes, plural, one {# byte} other {# bytes}})
ui-prompts.launch.none: No start audit yet (once the execution node is updated, each process start records a "start prompt audit").
ui-prompts.mode.allowlist: Only the sessions on the list
ui-prompts.my.effect: Changes apply to new conversations at once. Conversations already under way: Codex picks them up on the next turn; Claude Code keeps the system prompt it recorded when the conversation began until the context is next compacted — you can press "Compact now and apply" in that session's Session settings › Prompt. While the main switch for layered prompts is off, these settings are saved and apply once it is on.
